functions.name: respond
functions.description: Answer an ext: handler request delivered through onHandoffRequest (the browser-side hand-off engine is spinning, bounded, waiting for this). Respond as soon as the target extension acknowledged or declined.

events.name: onHandoffRequest
events.description: Fired when the browser-side hand-off engine (Settings > General > Download hand-off) reaches an ext:<id> handler and asks this relay to deliver the download message to that extension. The relay must answer with respond() - the engine's wait is bounded and a missing answer declines the download.
